I entered this circle at 25, and by this year—35. Ten whole years.
2023–2024 were my turning point. For the first time, my account crossed into eight figures.
Now I go check into five-star hotels—2000 yuan per night—and I don’t even blink. I have to bring along a suitcase and a hat with coin-world branding; wherever I go, people can spot “our own.”
Compared with my elders who work in factories or do e-commerce, my life is way more comfortable: no need to watch supply chains, no need to negotiate contracts, and no customers dragging payments. My worries are so much fewer.
People often ask me: What do you rely on to trade coins?
After thinking it through, the answer is actually very simple: mindset comes first, and skills come second.
Over the past few years, I’ve figured out a few “rules of mind” to share with brothers in the circle:
BTC is always the big brother. If you want to mix in this space, you have to keep your eyes on it. When it rises, the “mountain fort” (season opportunities) is there; when it falls, the little ones all have to follow along. Sometimes ETH may move independently, but don’t expect the counterfeit to hold up against the overall market.
$BTC  and USDT+ are the “early bird” board. Remember this line: When USDT goes up, be careful with Bitcoin. When Bitcoin surges hard, hold some USDT and lock in profits.
Two key time windows:
From 0–1 a.m., it’s easy to “stab needles” (temporary spikes/pullbacks). If you place orders before bed, you can often pick up free gains.
From 6–8 a.m., use it as a directional indicator for the day’s trend:
If the first half of the night is down and these two hours are still down, then close your eyes and add to your position—most likely the market will pull up that day.
If the first half of the night is up and these two hours are still up, then run quickly. Chances are it will drop later that day.
At 5 p.m., don’t zone out. Because of the time difference, once U.S. funds come in, this is when big volatility is most likely to hit.
“Black Friday +”？Don’t put too much faith in it. It may have fallen on Fridays, but it’s also risen and gone sideways—what matters most is the news and catalysts.
The most practical rule of all:
As long as it’s not a dead coin and has trading volume—if it drops, don’t panic. In three to five days, or even within a month, it will always come back.
If you have spare money, add in batches to lower your average cost so you can recover faster. If you don’t have spare money, just hold tough—there’s not much of a problem.
My most proud trade: I bought DOGE at 0.085 and just kept holding it until now—it’s already up over 20x.

The facts prove it: when trading coins comes down to the end, it’s really all about patience.

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

老铁们，这事的关键不在无人机本身，在于"没拦住"这三个字。

美国在中东的防空体系一直是其军事威慑力的核心支柱。你打过来我挡得住，大家就还能坐在谈判桌上聊天。但现在伊朗直接打脸——我打你了，你没拦住，然后呢？这就打破了过去几年的默契平衡。
